text: Inside new settlement (tick ~5854): objective 6 hint text 'Gather 20 wood and 5 stone' is clipped by the objective panel bottom edge; toast 'Enter your settlemen' truncated; large world-space label '0 here, 3/8 residents' overlaps the HUD at top. 'Send Caravan (Town era)' button shown but gated behind Town era while era is Camp (1/4); no hint on how far Town is.

Tick 7118: pressed B inside my own new settlement with 22 wood/5 stone -> 'Market is full. Cannot build stall.' NPCs (Dave Robinson, Mike Roberts, Lily Wood) built all 4 stalls within ~1000 ticks of founding while I was out gathering the 20 wood. Objective 6 'Build a market stall' completed at tick 6050 from an NPC's stall, not mine. The player never gets to build a stall in their own settlement. Also the objective 7 progress bar label is clipped ('nbers 5/10').

Tick ~7400: Sell Resources in own settlement -> 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 9 coins, and your cheapest good (sapling) sells for 16.' Market has 4/4 stalls but only 9 coins across merchants, so selling is impossible right after founding. Message is clear, but saplings are not in the Market Info price list, so the 16-coin sapling price is only visible in the error. Player holds 437 coins vs. merchants' 9 - economy lopsided.

Ticks 7894-8254: 'Build Farm' needs a confirm click, but the confirm window is about 1 game second (50 ticks). At ~9 tps / 2 fps a normal second click arrives too late: 'Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.' and the button re-arms. Three separate clicks on 'Confirm Build Farm' failed; only two clicks fired 1.7 s apart worked ('Farm built.'). The window should be in real time or longer.

Tick 8726: 'Send Caravan (Town era)' looks like an enabled button; clicking says 'This settlement needs a Storehouse before it can send caravans. The Storehouse is unlocked in the Town era.' Era box shows Village needs Day 1/3 plus Village/Members/Stalls; Town is two eras away. With a day = 10 game minutes, Storehouse + caravan cannot be reached in a ~30-minute session (at ~9-15 tps here, one game day is ~11-18 real minutes). Feedback text is clear; the Storehouse is never mentioned in the Village-era unlock list, so the path to it is only learned by clicking the caravan button.

Tick 8906-8938: Market Info says '4/4 stalls, 40 coins', but Sell Resources says 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 6 coins'. The one successful sale (tick 7574) sold a single wood for 20 coins; the player cannot pick which good or how many. Selling in your own settlement is coin-starved: you end up buying food to fund the merchants just so you can sell to them.
